from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_EVEN, ROUND_HALF_UP
print('half-even 0.125 @2 =', Decimal('0.125').quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN))
print('half-up   0.125 @2 =', Decimal('0.125').quantize(Decimal('0.01'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP))

from tinycsv import parse
cases = [
  ('', []),
  ('""', [['']]),
  ('a,"",c', [['a','','c']]),
  ('"a""b"', [['a"b']]),
  ('a,b\n\n\n\nc,d', [['a','b'],['c','d']]),
  ('"x\r\ny"', [['x\r\ny']]),
  ('a,"b,c",d', [['a','b,c','d']]),
  (',,', [['','','']]),
]
for text, want in cases:
    got = parse(text)
    print('OK ' if got==want else 'FAIL', repr(text), '->', got)
